prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: An airplane above clouds with coastlines below and a child looking at a simple map. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Airplane Day". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Airplane, pilot, land and sea.
Country, nation, new for you.
North and south, east and west.
Map the earth and take one trip.
Ship below and cloud above.
Return home with love for the world.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
